The inscription on the cane is ("Für Opa, mit liebe.") is not entirely correct German.
In German every noun is capitalized, so it would be "Für Opa, mit Liebe".
Is this intentional (hinting at a family with roots in Germany, but not natives anymore) or a simple error?

item.title: Hmmmmmmmmmmm
item.content:encoded:
A really good and humorous SCP, although a question has been floating in my head for quite a while now, What would happen if SCP-049 somehow comes across SCP-3476? The question popped up in my head when I remembered this specific line in 049's file
"Additionally, we've confiscated that pointed stick that SCP-049 keeps waving around. Part of this was due to standard confiscation protocols for the possessions of anomalies, and part because 049 really is a menace swinging it around like he does. The entity was displeased at first, but after we made some concessions in providing it with "test subjects" (which are, admittedly, more for the benefit of our own research) it warmed up to the idea." ^w^
